title: Consumer Mediation Cell Must Maintain Information

content.scenario: A Consumer Mediation Cell is required to submit a quarterly report to the District Commission. The cell must maintain certain information as per the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The Consumer Mediation Cell must maintain information under sub-section (4) of section 74, which includes a list of empanelled mediators, a list of cases handled by the cell, a record of proceedings, and any other information as may be specified by regulations.

user_queries: What information must a Consumer Mediation Cell maintain under sub-section (4) of section 74?
How often must a Consumer Mediation Cell submit a report to the District Commission?
Can a Consumer Mediation Cell maintain information beyond what is specified in the regulations?
